content.text:
The file is a clean generic landing-page template (nav + sections + dark mode + scrollspy). A few concrete things I'd improve:

1. Content is all placeholder text ("My Page", `hello@example.com`, `example.com`) — needs real values.
2. No mobile nav toggle — fine for 3 links but won't scale.
3. `og:image`/`twitter:image` meta tags are missing (recommended for social previews).
4. No `<h1>` distinction from title text — currently identical, minor SEO nit.
5. No error handling if `history` update on nav click (URL hash doesn't change page title/anchor for back-button use).

What would you like me to focus on — is this a real project (so I should swap in your actual name/content/links), or do you want structural/accessibility/performance improvements to the template itself?
